ranked_facts.why: The decreased sensation in the right arm cannot be explained by B2 (Inflammatory or Autoimmune Disorder) or B3 (Vascular Disorder) as these conditions would likely present with more systemic or widespread symptoms, whereas B1 (Neoplastic Disorder) and B4 (Traumatic or Compressive Disorder) could directly affect the arm's sensation due to local compression or invasion.

The significant weight loss of 17 pounds in one month is more indicative of a neoplastic process (B1), which can cause cachexia, than of inflammatory, vascular, or traumatic/compressive disorders, which are less likely to cause such rapid and significant weight loss without other prominent symptoms.
